verdict.rationale: Klaviyo documents building automations (flows) on every plan, including the free plan. These flows trigger on Klaviyo events and send notifications with no manual step. The pricing page also lists 'Schedule recurring tasks' and 'Create campaigns + flows', and the AI features page says Customer Agent and K:AI act automatically. A community user confirms an event-triggered 'Haven't seen you in a while' email can be set up with no extra work. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on flow trigger, condition and scheduling configuration; evidence on monitoring or error handling for background runs; recent independent hands-on corroboration (the community report is old); clarity on whether Composer-built automations run fully autonomously, since they are 'for your review, with you in control'.
